items.evidence: Fixed in 00b98c8. The README and the book use the plugin and say not to add a second RemotePlugin. Proof: tests/docs_drift.rs::the_readme_does_not_tell_the_reader_to_register_a_method_the_plugin_registers and the_book_ variant.

must_fix.evidence: README.md Quick Start and developer workflow, book/MACOS_SERVICE.md, docs/installation/bevy-setup.md, docs/quick-start.md, docs/troubleshooting/README.md (twice), docs/tutorials/README.md

items.title: the release gate's `cargo doc -D warnings` step failed: an undeclared `ahash` feature, five unclosed HTML tags, two broken intra-doc links
items.evidence: Fixed in c21045c and 3198e6f. The `ahash` feature gates were wrong -- ahash is an unconditional dependency, so the fast-hash arm had never compiled. The tags and links are fixed. Proof: the release gate's doc step, which now passes for both crates.

items.title: the `bevy_fairy` crate has never been published; publishing a new name is the human's decision
items.evidence: Prepared: the manifest, the changelog, the README's install section, and `.github/workflows/release.yml` for trusted publishing. The tag is not pushed and nothing is published. The human must (a) publish the crate name and (b) add the crates.io trusted publisher for the workflow. Published 2026-10-23 17:52 UTC by local publish (the human approved the first publish of the name); https://crates.io/crates/bevy_fairy/0.2.0. The trusted publisher for later versions is B-043.
